role: The agent form of an act (player.h struct act_agent: holds, presses, hotbar, ctrl, gui ops), resolved inside the client tick where the oracle's agent mode runs Act.applyGui and Act.applyInput: act_agent_gui runs each gui op under the screen handleInput finds (a close takes the screen away, a dead player's close opens GuiGameOver) and drops the ones Act refuses, counting them; act_agent_input fills the tape-form keys, hotbar, focus, left click counter and ctrl when the input block runs (no screen, or GuiInventory over the player's own container). The env pool's acts (csrc/runtime) carry one; a tape's act does not.

structs.name: act_agent
structs.java: Act (agent form: hold, press, hb, ctrl, gui)

notes: lane/envpool. Held to the oracle by pool_gate --agent oracle/tests: each recording's own script's agent acts replayed through the pool, every row against test_snapshots' records (25 of 27 gate recordings with scripts in the agent form; chest-chain-s1's script is not the one its tape was made with). The aim form and the chat ops are not in it (csrc/runtime/agent.c refuses no aim: it is absent from struct pool_act).
